page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.re6p-redis.xlarge is a dedicated virtual machine instance based on the KVM hypervisor and the x86_64 architecture. Compute capacity is delivered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor operating at a base frequency of 2.5 GHz, configured with 2 physical cores and 4 vCPUs via hyperthreading. The hardware features 32 KB of L1 data cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and 35 MB of shared L3 cache. Vector extensions include AVX, AVX-512F, and AVX512_VNNI, alongside cryptographic acceleration through AES instructions. The instance supplies 16.0 GB of system memory, yielding a 4.0 GB per vCPU allocation, and provides a baseline network throughput of 2 Gbps without bundled local storage or GPU acceleration.

In synthetic performance evaluations, the instance demonstrates entry-level computational metrics. The stress-ng single-core score of 1317.59 and multi-core score of 3505.31 place the instance within the lower 25% bracket of comparable hardware. Similarly, PassMark CPU testing yielded 4278.13 points, with extended instruction handling reaching 3128.75. Memory performance reflects moderate efficiency, registering a PassMark memory score of 2139.93 in the mid-tier range, while large block uncached read and write bandwidths reached 25.91 GB/sec and 22.82 GB/sec respectively. Multi-threaded bzip3 decompression and static web serving throughput showed restrained throughput, indicating that the instance offers resource-balanced utility rather than peak compute throughput.

The primary operational tradeoff centers on moderate processor throughput combined with the reliance on network-attached storage. The hardware profile is structurally suited for memory-centric microservices, lightweight Redis or key-value caching layers, background queue processing, and low-traffic web serving. Deployments benefit from predictable dedicated CPU scheduling without the cost overhead of excess cores or dedicated hardware accelerators.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.re6p-redis.xlarge is an x86_64 instance configured with 4 dedicated vCPUs across 2 physical Intel Xeon 8269CY cores running at 2.5 GHz. The platform includes 16.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, while lacking bundled local storage and GPU accelerators. Hardware acceleration includes AVX-512F, AVX512_VNNI, and AES-NI instruction sets, accompanied by a 2 Gbps baseline network interface. Benchmark results indicate modest computational throughput, with PassMark CPU and stress-ng scores positioning in the lower quartile of tested systems. Memory subsystem evaluations demonstrate average bandwidth performance in PassMark tests alongside 25.91 GB/sec uncached read bandwidth. Given its compute density and lack of local non-volatile storage, this instance functions as an entry tier for dedicated cache nodes, lightweight key-value stores, intermediate background processing, and standard utility microservices where intensive single-core throughput is not mandatory.
